reviews.text: Thank you so much Zach and Brian with Riddle Brothers Roofing. You were very through, explained everything to me, and even went back over everything when I did not understand. They did my 4200 house roof in 1 day. They all were very professional, clean, and respectful of my property. I will definitely use them again in the future for any roof repair or replacement. Thank you Riddle Roofing!
reviews.author: SEAN ROSS

reviews.text: After a big hailstorm earlier this year, I had a full roof replacement recently completed by Riddle Brothers and couldn't be happier with the results. The quality of work, communication, professionalism, and support are all world class. I really appreciate the attention to detail on all aspects of the project. With my previous roof, there were actually a few technical and installation issues that I was not aware of, and Riddle Brothers identified these and explained what they will do differently to update things. Always humble and never an upsell, rather just making sure I was aware and understood any changes. One of the changes I am particularly thrilled with is the attic ventilation improvements. My existing roof had some ventilation configuration errors causing years of increased heat and humidity accumulation, and energy use in the summer. The corrections for this were simple and not a cost increase and make not just my attic, but entire home more comfortable and energy efficient long-term. Simple details like this can really make a big difference in overall project outcomes beyond just roof durability. I still haven't even found a single nail on my property after their final cleanup. That is a level of detail and quality focus you will never get from the storm chasing roofers that flood the neighborhoods every time a big storm hits. Riddle Brothers is a local established family-owned company that I trust will be around to support their work for a long time. If you want a quality roof installed properly Riddle Brothers delivers.
reviews.author: Derek Vandagriff

reviews.text: Riddle brothers did an amazing job replacing our roof. From the first meeting going over what to expect to completion of the job they were fantastic. I can't say enough about these guys and their professionalism. I highly recommend them to anyone needing to get the job done. Thank you again Zack, Walter and team for all that you do.
reviews.author: Rob Hill

reviews.text: Tony Foster of Riddle Brothers roofing helped us to have a seamless, simple experience from start to finish with the new roof at our office that was recently finished. Riddle brothers also installed a new roof at our home three years ago. Tony Foster also took us step by step through that process. Thank you Tony for making this a pleasant experience and providing excellent service throughout the process. I highly recommend Riddle brothers if you need a new roof and Tony Foster and his customer service are as good as it gets.
reviews.author: mark boren

reviews.text: Grateful for Tony Foster and the work he put in, he truly went above and beyond and communicated in a timely manner throughout the whole process. Tony, and his team were great, He took care of everything and got me a new roof, new gutters and interior ceiling work.  Highly recommend working with this company.
reviews.author: K P

reviews.text: Can’t say enough about Tony with Riddle Brothers Construction. This guys really helped in all aspect of the process. He took photographs and documented everything for our insurance company. Actually spoke with my insurance company really expedited the process. His crew was punctual, quick, thorough and did an amazing job with cleanup. I would absolutely use them again in the future. We are actually going to have our house painted and new gutters installed in the near future. Need help with you home? Call Riddle Brothers…. They will do quality work at a fair price.
reviews.author: Autumn Seibert

reviews.text: The roof, garage doors, gutters, shutters, windows, and screens were all replaced by the Riddle Brothers just a month before we purchased our home. They made sure we, as the new homeowners, had all of their contact information and have been incredibly responsive to any questions we've had since. Tony Foster even came out in person to meet us—he was friendly, professional, and made a great impression.
reviews.author: Julie Cantrell

reviews.text:
Zach Riddle and Team provided the absolute best service. Their attention to detail and professionalism is immeasurable! Throughout the process the entire Team went above and beyond to ensure our satisfaction.
They have excellent communication, and at no time was I unclear of next steps. Also, I appreciated the guidance on color and product selection.
The quality and workmanship is unmatched! They truly transformed the look of my home.
The work was completed in a timely manner with outstanding cleanup.
I often thought about selling my house but Riddle Brothers Roofing & Construction have helped me fall back in love with my home again.
Thank you!
reviews.author: zamiris white
